title: Can AI End World Poverty?
blurb: Recorded at the 2025 World Bank–IMF Annual Meetings: what the AI revolution looks like for 3.5 billion people in the Global South, from farmers with smartphones to teachers in classrooms without Wi-Fi, and why electricity, not algorithms, may be the biggest barrier.

title: The Great Divide: Can AI Close (or Widen) the World's Wealth Gap?
blurb: Part two: which jobs are most exposed to AI, why women and urban workers are likely to feel the first wave, and what happens when AI meets energy poverty.

title: Evaluating AI: What's New and Why the Development Sector Should Care
blurb: Panel with IDinsight, the Agency Fund, and OpenAI on how to evaluate generative AI tools in developing countries.
